name: requirement-checks
description: Check whether a produced artifact satisfies explicit requirements.
instructions: Judge only against the listed requirements. A model check complements deterministic validation; it does not replace it.

passes.instructions: Does the artifact satisfy every listed requirement?

missing_requirements.instructions: Which listed requirements are not satisfied?

review_depth.instructions: How much additional human review does this need? 0 = none, 1 = full review.
